description: Source code for a memory technology device (MTD) manipulation tool, including functions for opening, checking, erasing, writing, verifying, and dumping MTD devices, as well as command-line interface handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the command-line tool, parsing arguments and executing MTD operations such as unlock, erase, write, verify, dump, and reboot.

methods.name: mtd_open
methods.description: Opens an MTD device, handling device number resolution via /proc/mtd.

methods.name: mtd_check_open
methods.description: Checks and retrieves information about an MTD device, setting global variables for size, erasesize, and type.

methods.name: mtd_block_is_bad
methods.description: Checks if a block at a given offset is bad (for NAND flash).

methods.name: mtd_erase_block
methods.description: Erases a block at a specified offset.

methods.name: mtd_write_buffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer to an MTD device at a specified offset.

methods.name: image_check
methods.description: Checks the magic number of an image file to determine its format.

methods.name: mtd_check
methods.description: Validates access to an MTD device, handling multiple device partitions.

methods.name: mtd_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks one or multiple MTD devices.

methods.name: mtd_erase
methods.description: Erases an entire MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_dump
methods.description: Outputs the contents of an MTD device to stdout.

methods.name: mtd_verify
methods.description: Verifies the content of an MTD device against a file via MD5 checksum.

methods.name: indicate_writing
methods.description: Displays status message indicating data is being written.

methods.name: mtd_write
methods.description: Writes an image file to an MTD device, handling partitioning, bad blocks, and optional FIS layout.

methods.name: mtd_write_jffs2
methods.description: Appends a file to a JFFS2 partition on an MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_fixtrx
methods.description: Fixes checksum in TRX header (if applicable).

methods.name: mtd_resetbc
methods.description: Resets the U-Boot boot counter (if applicable).

methods.name: mtd_fixseama
methods.description: Fixes checksum in SEAMA header (if applicable).

methods.name: mtd_fixwrg
methods.description: Fixes checksum in WRG header (if applicable).

methods.name: mtd_fixwrgg
methods.description: Fixes checksum in WRGG03 header (if applicable).

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line tool.

methods.name: do_reboot
methods.description: Reboots the system, attempting normal and forced reboot methods.
